senses.gloss:
आञ्छ् €1 P. (आञ्छति, आनञ्छ, आञ्छित)
—1 To lengthen, stretch, extend.
—2 To make straight.
—3 To regulate, bring or draw into the right position; set (as a bone
 or leg); चकयोगेनाञ्छेदूर्वस्थि निर्गतम् Suśr.

आञ्छनम् Setting (a bone or leg); bringing into the right position
 by stretching, bending, or drawing.
